notes.title: Royal Vermin Demo Update
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone!
[/b][/p][p]We made some changes on our demo, including bugs fixing and adding some cool stuff!

[/p][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where only the first 4 controllers could be used when more than 4 controllers were connected[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing translation text[/p][/*][*][p]Linux players can actually see their outlines now (they were being shy apparently)[/p][/*][*][p]Special rounds were getting a bit too predictable - gave the randomizer a good kick[/p][/*][*][p]Improved hit player projection physics[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players would run indefinitely if the menu was opened while running[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where dashing before being hit could sometimes cancel the hit projection[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could get stuck inside the customization container when falling back into it[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p]Game politely pauses itself when your controller rage-quits on you[/p][/*][*][p]Added new splash screen intro sequence[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced camera movement in "Falling Container" special game mode - camera now moves upward[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple players dying simultaneously are now both considered winners! Communism in action[/p][/*][*][p]Threw in a helpful video for Steam Remote Play (because coordinating 4 people online is hard enough)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Increased field of view (FOV) for the first race special round[/p][/*][*][p]Players and balls can no longer pass through the bottom of the basketball net (house rules!)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a tiny grace period at race start so you don't instantly eat dirt[/p][/*][/list]
